name: prd-v09-feedback-loop-setup
description: Establish channels and processes for capturing and processing post-launch feedback during PRD v0.9 Go-to-Market. Triggers on requests to set up feedback systems, capture user input, or when user asks "how do we collect feedback?", "feedback loop", "user research", "post-launch feedback", "customer feedback", "NPS", "voice of customer". Outputs CFD- entries specialized for post-launch feedback capture.
